Common questions

  • What if I already have a website?

    Either package can replace the site you have now. Webco Media builds the new one. Webco Cloud then looks after hosting, the domain and email.

  • Can I upgrade later?

    Yes. Start with Essential when you have one location and a straightforward offer. When you need separate course and location pages, we move you onto the Training Provider Website and quote that work.

  • What if I already have a domain?

    We connect the domain you already own to the website and to your business email. A new domain can be registered during setup when you need one.

  • What if I add more courses or locations?

    Essential covers one main location and your core course information. Several courses or locations, each with its own page, are what the Training Provider Website is for.

  • Is booking, a shop, or custom software included?

    Both packages are enquiry websites. Online booking, ecommerce and bespoke systems are quoted separately.

One location, or several?

Choose Essential for a smaller setup. Choose the Training Provider Website when courses or locations need their own pages.
